stop_rules: stop on any source, plan, bundle, manifest, topology, material, receipt-count, schema, identity, or finiteness drift
do not change the model, feature/subspace transform, J-lens head, threshold search, eligibility gate, comparator, tie rule, or placement separation after reading outcomes
if no placement has an eligible primary two-key threshold pair, stop before detector confirmation
if one placement fails, that placement remains closed even if the other passes
do not open or execute confirmation until the public result and exact private candidate hash are committed and a new authorization is frozen
